description: StethoFuse only: cache anonymous static homepage at edge; browser revalidates
expression: http.host eq "stethofuse.ashraf-alsaloul.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.uri.query eq "" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "")

description: StethoFuse only: bypass private API, accounts, auth actions, versions and mutations
expression: http.host eq "stethofuse.ashraf-alsaloul.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/app") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/static/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/login" "/register" "/forgot-password" "/reset-password" "/verify-email" "/deployment-version.json" "/health"} or not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne ""))
